notes:
p044 ends with a complete sentence and p045 opens with the # heading, so p045 has no '+'. p046 opens with an indented new paragraph, so no '+'. p047 continues item (٧) of p046 («...وعافية» / «الأبدان...»), so its marker is <<<ص:047+>>>. p048 opens with list item (٧), so no '+'. No footnotes on any page.

p045 heading: the marks are copied as printed. «اليُسْرِيَّة» has damma, sukun, kasra and shadda+fatha. «الصِّديقيَّة» has shadda+kasra on ṣād only, nothing on dal or qaf. «الدرقاويَّة» and «الشاذليَّة» have shadda+fatha on the yeh. This matches the p001 title.

p045 list numbers: the dash spacing was measured from pixel ink runs at 600 dpi. Single digits sit 10-25 px from the dash, which is glyph side-bearing only, so no space is written before the dash. In item ١ the gap is 60 px, a real space, so it is written «١ - ورد». In item ١٠ the zero sits 30 px from the dash, which is the zero glyph's own side-bearing (١ to ٠ inside the number is 41 px), so it is written «١٠-آداب». After the dash, items ٧ and ١٠ have 14-15 px (no space): «٧-الصلوات», «١٠-آداب». All other items have 28-60 px (a space). This follows keyA b50 («١٦ -نضاخة» kept as printed).

Normalized spacing (CONVENTIONS §2: no space before ) or .): p045 «(ورد الأساس )» → «(ورد الأساس)», «العصر )» → «العصر)», «الصديقية .» → «الصديقية.». p048 «ﷺ .» → «ﷺ.». p046 «رَّحِيمٌ ﴾» → «رَّحِيمٌ﴾».

Parenthesized list numbers (pp.046-048): the print has the closing paren tight against the next word in most items, e.g. «(١)أعوذ», «(٧)منظومة». Following earlier keyA batches (b02) and the CONVENTIONS template «(٣) …», they are written with one space: «(١) أعوذ». Arbiter, please align with keyB if it differs.

Tanween by printed position. Fathatan after the alif: «يومياً صباحاً» (p045 item ١), and every «صباحاً», «أيضاً», «يومياً» on pp.046-047. Fathatan before the alif: «يوميًّا صباحًا» (p045 item ٣, where the yeh carries shadda + fathatan), «يوميًا» (item ٥: fathatan only, no shadda, checked at 1400 dpi), «صباحًا» (item ٦). «مساءً» always has fathatan on the hamza.

p045 item ٣: «الصِّدِّيقِيةِ» has shadda+kasra on ṣād and on dal, kasra on qaf, nothing on the second yeh, and kasra on the teh marbuta. Item ٦: «الْإِمَامِ» has a sukun on the lam.

Quran (p046). 73:20 (part) and 42:19 match the Tanzil text exactly (with madda as alif+U+0653 and shadda before the vowel). Sukun is printed as the khāʾ-head shape and written ْ. The silent alif in «تُقَدِّمُوا۟» and «وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟» is a round zero (U+06DF). Waqf signs: ۚ after «أَجْرًا», ۖ after «ٱللَّهَ» and «يَشَآءُ». «لَطِيفٌۢ» has the iqlab small mim. The final «رَّحِيمٌ» of 73:20 is printed with plain dammatan and NO small mim (Tanzil has ٌۢ there), so no ۢ is written. The references keep the printed format «[المزمل:٢٠]» and «[الشورى:١٩]», with no space after the colon. «الشورى» is plain ى (body-font auto small alif).

p047: «عطاءِ اللَّهِ» has a kasra printed under the heh of the Allah ligature (checked at 1500 dpi). Following earlier keyA practice (CONVENTIONS §2, write them all), this is written اللَّهِ. Other «الله» with no case vowel are written plain. The bold paragraph «وننصح ... على الانترنت.» is set entirely in bold against regular text, so it is wrapped in ** (its final full stop is bold too). The first word has two nun teeth: «وننصح». «محتويات أخرى:» is a standalone bold title ending in a colon, so it is ###. Tatweel in «المنســوبةُ» is dropped.

p046: «وأوراد الطريقة القادرية» is a bold run-in at the start of the paragraph, written as **…**. Numbers are in reading order: ٦٤٥, ١٢٩, ١١, ١٠٠, ١٠٠٠. p048: tatweel in «لسيـــدي» and «صبـــاح» is dropped. ﷺ is the printed glyph. «الدِّرَعِي» has shadda+kasra on dal, fatha on ra and kasra on ʿayn. Each item that wraps (p047 items ١ and ٦, p048 items ٧ and ١٢) is joined into one paragraph.
